lines.text: What if all the air on Earth turned into *helium*... for five seconds?
Same pressure, same temperature. Just a different gas.
Everyone in Times Square sounds like this.
In helium, sound travels almost *three times faster*. Your vocal cords buzz at the same pitch, but the air in your throat rings much higher.
And the pigeons? Helium is *seven times* lighter than air. Their wings have almost nothing to push.
Follow for more. What should change next?
